about_the_game:
THE OTHER SIDE OF THE COIN
MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS: SHADOW OF ABADDON is an expansion pack that expands on the story of the base game with an entire second campaign (at the same size as the first), featuring new gameplay mechanics, locations and characters. Play as the antagonist, Abaddon, who's crime syndicate is caught in a conflict over the Alxyte parasite.

CAST YOUR SHADOW
Abaddon is ruthless and with a far more aggressive move set than Clive, letting him parry and slash through hordes of enemies. Prepare to fight through a new set of open-space levels, with broader corridors filled with far more enemies than before. The gritty underbelly of Tokydon's streets await you...

AND FOR THE LORE ENJOYERS...
Discover the secrets of The Wolf and the true nature of Abaddon's criminal organisation in a plot that finally ties MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS directly into the events of BANE MURRAIN.

content_descriptors.notes:
SHADOW OF ABADDON contains darker themes than the base game, with mentions of drugs, alcohol and general crime.
The DLC follows the villain of Clive's story and is not intended to encourage these actions.

It also has about as much violence as the base game (alot).
